# LLCTaxCheck.com — 50-State Statutory Database & API Schema (LLMs Full Spec)

## Computational Methodology
For any entity:
1. `BaseStatutoryDue = BaseTax + AnnualizedReportFee + MemberFee`
2. `GrossReceiptsSurcharge` = Evaluated by state-specific bracket tiers (e.g., California FTB 3536).
3. `AssetTax` = Evaluated by in-state assets (e.g., Wyoming $0.0002/$1 over $300k).
4. `LatePenalties` = Assessed when `FilingDate > StatutoryDueDate`. Flat or percentage based on statutory code.
5. `TotalStatutoryDue = BaseStatutoryDue + GrossReceiptsSurcharge + AssetTax + LatePenalties + StatutoryInterest`.

## All 50 States + DC Summary
- Alabama (AL): $100 min Business Privilege Tax (Form BPT-IN) + $0-$100 report. Due March 15.
- Alaska (AK): $100 biennial report ($50/yr). Due Jan 2 odd years.
- Arizona (AZ): $0 annual report.
- Arkansas (AR): $150 annual franchise tax. Due May 1.
- California (CA): $800 minimum annual franchise tax (FTB 3522) + Gross receipts fee up to $11,790 (FTB 3536) + $20 biennial SOI. Due April 15.
- Colorado (CO): $10 periodic report. Due anniversary month window.
- Connecticut (CT): $80 annual report. Due March 31.
- Delaware (DE): $400 annual franchise tax (HB 400). Due June 1. $200 penalty after June 1 + 1.5%/mo on $600 delinquent balance.
- District of Columbia (DC): $300 biennial report (Form BRA-25, $150/yr). Due April 1.
- Florida (FL): $138.75 annual report. Due May 1. $400 late fee on May 2.
- Georgia (GA): $50 annual registration. Due April 1.
- Hawaii (HI): $15 annual report. Due quarter of formation.
- Idaho (ID): $0 annual report. Due anniversary month.
- Illinois (IL): $75 annual report (Form LLC-50.1). Due 1st day of anniversary month.
- Indiana (IN): $50 biennial report ($25/yr online). Due anniversary month.
- Iowa (IA): $45 biennial report (odd years). Due March 31.
- Kansas (KS): $50 annual report ($55 paper). Due 15th day of 4th month.
- Kentucky (KY): $15 annual report. Due June 30.
- Louisiana (LA): $30 annual report. Due anniversary date.
- Maine (ME): $85 annual report. Due June 1.
- Maryland (MD): $300 annual report (Form 1). Due April 15.
- Massachusetts (MA): $500 annual report. Due anniversary date.
- Michigan (MI): $25 annual statement. Due Feb 15.
- Minnesota (MN): $0 annual renewal. Due Dec 31.
- Mississippi (MS): $0 annual report. Due April 15.
- Missouri (MO): $0 annual report.
- Montana (MT): $20 annual report. Due April 15.
- Nebraska (NE): $10 biennial report (odd years). Due April 1.
- Nevada (NV): $150 Annual List + $200 State Business License ($350 total). Due anniversary month end.
- New Hampshire (NH): $100 annual report. Due April 1.
- New Jersey (NJ): $75 annual report. Due anniversary month end.
- New Mexico (NM): $0 annual report.
- New York (NY): $9 biennial statement + $25-$4,500 IT-204-LL filing fee based on gross income.
- North Carolina (NC): $200 annual report. Due April 15.
- North Dakota (ND): $50 annual report. Due Nov 15.
- Ohio (OH): $0 annual report. CAT applies over $3M gross receipts.
- Oklahoma (OK): $25 annual certificate. Due anniversary date.
- Oregon (OR): $100 annual report. Due anniversary date.
- Pennsylvania (PA): $7 annual report (under Act 122). Due Sept 30.
- Rhode Island (RI): $50 annual report. Due May 1.
- South Carolina (SC): $0 annual report.
- South Dakota (SD): $50 annual report. Due 1st day of anniversary month.
- Tennessee (TN): $300 minimum annual report ($50/member, max $3,000) + F&E tax. Due April 15.
- Texas (TX): $0 franchise tax under $2.47M revenue threshold + mandatory PIR (Form 05-102). Due May 15.
- Utah (UT): $18 annual renewal. Due anniversary date.
- Vermont (VT): $35 annual report. Due within 2.5 months of fiscal close.
- Virginia (VA): $50 annual registration. Due anniversary month end.
- Washington (WA): $60 annual report. Due anniversary month end.
- West Virginia (WV): $25 annual report. Due July 1.
- Wisconsin (WI): $25 annual report. Due end of formation quarter.
- Wyoming (WY): $60 minimum license tax ($0.0002/dollar over $300k in-state assets). Due 1st day of anniversary month.
